title: Presidential Candidates on the Campaign Trail
subtitle: Schedule included walks, motorcades and meetings with supporters
excerpt: Presidential candidates carry out campaign activities
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The schedule of the presidential candidates included a variety of campaign activities.

The activities carried out comprised walks, motorcades, leaflet distribution and meetings with supporters, as well as interviews on radio and podcasts.

Campaign Activities

These actions are part of the electoral calendar and aim to increase visibility and support for the candidates.

With information from Agência Brasil.
